## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes (and `--all-features` if backends changed)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, crate READMEs, `CHANGELOG.md`, `todo.md` roadmap boxes)
- [ ] New public APIs are documented (`cargo doc --workspace --no-deps` is warning-free)
